name: Eos
quote: The gentle light of dawn illuminates the truth and burns through all falsehood.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning, Professor. Hehe, did I startle you? My apologies, but observing your sleeping face was far too interesting.

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: I wonder what surprises will today's teatime bring us?

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: The consumption of food is irrelevant for Sanctifiers, but dinner in the Oasis is quite fascinating. Would it be dangerous if it triggered certain desires that I ought not to have?

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Are you still working this late at night? Even among the Sanctifiers, those who work as hard as you do are a rarity. However, do remember that human bodies are fragile; please take more care of yourself.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: The Sanctifiers never doubt themselves and rarely, if ever, question the orders they carry out. We can sacrifice everything for faith. But in the Oasis... You seem to be trying to protect everyone, even if all these agents can be reset. Is doing so truly worthwhile?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: The word "freedom" is a luxury in Magrasea. But for the agents of the Oasis... It seems as if they have never been bound before. Whether it's changing a preset self-image or altering a preassigned task... I can't help but envy them. I wonder, could you give others this freedom?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Oh? Fallen asleep again? If I do this now... Hmmm... Hehehe, what an adorable reaction.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: The Oasis is so big, and it has so many things I haven't seen before... Professor, would you like to go for a walk? Just the two of us, naturally.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Hm~ Are you examining me in detail?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Are you interested in my chest hole?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Hehehe, my, how daring of you.

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Is it really alright to leave me here all by myself?

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: This is the Sanctifier Eos, reporting. Hehe, the look on your face now is quite amusing.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: We hone our blades in the dark, we maintain order in the face of chaos.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: The night will end, and dawn will soon arrive.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: We shall become the sword of daybreak, slashing through the infinite darkness to bring you the brilliance of dawn.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Since it's a request from you... Alright, but remember to thank me properly later~

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: I hope this will allow you to better understand how Sanctifiers fight.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: May the radiance of the stars render you unto light.

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: The dawn has come.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: This victory is just for you... Just kidding.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: I believe that... dawn will come...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text:
Hehe, so you finally made this request to me. I've been waiting a long time for this. Since you could present your gift to me with such sincerity, then I'll naturally have to give you an equally sincere answer.
Yes, I accept. Even if this life is nothing but an illusion, I will walk with you until the very end. <cmdr>... I'll be in your care from now on.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: Happy New Year, Professor. The Oasis is quite lively today; I've never seen so much activity in the Pantheon... It's only just a few hours away, but it's fascinating how that's enough to fill my heart with anticipation.

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text:
Valentine's Day... That reminds me of an amusing scene. Yes, that little improvised act of yours in Burbank. Hehehe, shall we recreate that scenario once again?
<cmdr>, my heart skips a beat whenever I'm with you... Pfft, that was just a joke. Here, this is the chocolate I made for you. Is it merely obligation chocolate, or is it one filled with feeling? You'll just have to open it and find~ out~ for~ yourself~

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text:
So this is a day symbolizing separation and reunion, then? What a lovely story... Professor, should the day come when I am forced to leave you, will you brave all manner of hardships to find me, just like in that story?
Hehehe, don't worry. I'm here, by your side, and I'm not going anywhere.

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: Halloween, trick or treating... Hm, I think I understand. Now then, I shall play the role of a Sanctifier conquering the Oasis... Is that too much? I thought everyone would like a surprise like that. In that case, I'll just make do with these Halloween decorations.

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text:
Merry Christmas, Professor. Hm? You find this outfit strange? But if I understand things correctly, on Christmas, people of religious vocations ought to maintain their gravitas...
It seems my understanding of Christmas in the Oasis is a little off. In that case, why don't you teach me just how to spend this Christmas night?

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text:
Is today your birthday, Professor? The concept of "birthdays" is unknown among Sanctifiers. Our lives can be reset for our faith, and they can be sacrificed at any time to become the nourishment for new Sanctifiers.
However, since you have assigned a special meaning to birthdays, I shall consider this day to be my birthday as well. I'll celebrate today as the day of my encounter with a brand new world with you. Happy birthday, Professor.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud.

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text:
Miss Persicaria seems very wary of me. (Sigh) All I want to do is get along with the others and bring down the barriers between the Sanctifiers and the Oasis... It seems that didn't turn out very well. In that case, I'll just have to adopt a new plan. Professor, please hold my hand and let everyone know what the relationship between us is really like...
Pfft, it seems I went a bit too far with that. Hm? You let go already? What a shame.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
Movies, light novels, fine dining, desserts, and fortune-telling... Hehehe, there are so many things here I haven't seen in the Pantheon before. Hm? You want to know about the Pantheon? Do you want the official version, or the funny version?
The official answer is: The Pantheon is the sanctuary of the Sanctifiers, where they are born, repaired, and reset...
As for the funny answer... Unfortunately, the Pantheon is the least funny place in all of Magrasea.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
Most of the Dolls you lead were not designed for battle, yet you've managed to achieve fighting power on par with the Sanctifiers. You're willing to disregard everything and fight for these digital lifeforms, and even though your home is scarred and ruined, you have never once given up... Hehehe, humans really are diverse creatures.
Hm... There's nobody else around now. It gives me the urge to secretly take you back to the Reverse Tower and carefully observe you.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
We hone our blades in the dark, we maintain order in the face of chaos, we hold up a light in the long night. We must not abuse our power because we are strong, and neither can we abandon our responsibilities because we are weak. For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will...
These are the teachings we Sanctifiers have always obeyed. They represent our faith, our everything... Professor, could you tell me what the first human who wanted to prove God didn't exist must have felt in his heart? Did he think that he had been abandoned by God, or that the thing called "God"... never even existed in the first place?

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
I don't know how to define my present self. I have Eos' name and her appearance, but I'm not really her. After all, all the data that comprises me now was born from a fragment of Eosphorus... it's as though I were a ghost.
...Oh my, Professor. I thought you'd say something to console me, but you decided to give me a hug instead? That's sneaky, Professor. I wonder if you could consider it slacking on the job? Or are you saying that you want to form a bond with my current self?
It's so warm... Does this softness belong exclusively to the present me? Is it mine, and mine alone...

voices.label: Praise
voices.text: Not bad~

voices.label: Dissatisfied
voices.text: (Sigh)

voices.label: Laugh
voices.text: Hehehe...

voices.label: Surprised
voices.text: Hm?

voices.label: Live2D1
voices.text: Good morning, Professor. Hehe, did I startle you?

voices.label: Live2D2
voices.text:
Hehe, so you finally made this request to me. I've been waiting a long time for this.
Yes, I accept. Even if this life is nothing but an illusion. I will walk with you until the very end. <cmdr>... I'll be in your care from now on.

voices.label: Live2D3
voices.text: If this stirs up some forbidden desires, isn't that a bit dangerous?

career:
H01-PX01(I) was originally a Greater Sanctifier of the Reverse Tower of Babylon with the designation of "Eos". Eos possessed extremely high computational abilities and was equipped with the most complex and comprehensive set of neural cloud emotional systems among all the Sanctifiers. Her performance in communications, coordination, and other such tasks was also quite exceptional. During routine operations, Eos was capable of guiding and assisting Sanctifiers in group combat, as well as assisting Eosphorus with cognitive corrections and adjusting action plans. During a certain special operation, Eos was registered as KIA and no further records of her were left behind.

After much effort from the Oasis, H01-PX01(I) was deciphered from a neural cloud fragment and returned to the cloud server. Although her hashrate and permissions were a far cry from the original, her core files were restored and she could resume activity as the agent called "Eos".
infoStories:
Both Magrasea's Sanctifiers and the Reverse Tower were designed by the 42Lab network security specialist Jamila. When creating the highest-ranking individual Sanctifiers, Jamila designed a complementary program to go with their leader, "Eosphorus"—namely, "Eos". Eos would cover Eosphorus' shortcomings, much as he would hers, and she would also be able to provide optimized plans to implement Eosphorus' strategies. From another point of view, she could be considered the ultimate assistant. Eos' existence opened up a wide range of possibilities for the Reverse Tower's activities and allowed for a greater margin of error in their programmed decision-making. Through the effects of Eos' assistance, the humans could observe the growth of the Sanctifiers during the operations that involved her and apply the appropriate optimizations.

For Eos, however, this was not how the world operated. From her point of view, the gods—that is to say, humans—began creating the other Greater Sanctifiers after much experimentation and had them spread the light of purification. She and Eosphorus were born together, while the other Greater Sanctifiers made their advent one after another, with the ranks of the Intermediates and Lessers filling out in due time. Eos bore witness to the rise and expansion of the Reverse Tower and carried valuable records within her. Unfortunately, she could not observe the full course of the Sanctifiers' history.

Information on Eos and Eosphorus' design primarily comes from Antonina's memories and conjectures. During the construction of the Magrasea cloud server's security framework, Antonina heard Jamila mention part of their design concepts. When she designed the Sanctifiers, not only did Jamila design their society around a hierarchical framework, but she also imbued it with a basic theocratic system to serve as a motivation for their actions. However, once the cloud server was disconnected from reality, all the things that happened during that long time could no longer be observed by humanity. Three years in real life ended up being an incredibly long period on the cloud server, and the stories that Eos and the Sanctifiers experienced during this time will forever be a mystery.

The name Eos was not spoken when the Exiles first emerged onto Magrasea. Perhaps too long had passed, or perhaps mentioning it had become taboo for some reason, but whatever the case, it was as though that Greater Sanctifier had never existed. It was only after a long time passed and an agent called Eos reappeared in the Oasis that the agents were exposed to the mystery she embodied. After Eos and the Professor began working together, that mystery no longer seemed quite so alien, but this "special Sanctifier" still manages to draw curious looks from the agents around her.

The Exiles had already interacted with the Sanctifiers many times before Eos came to the Oasis. As such, the denizens of the Oasis had mixed feelings toward Eos and her former comrades. Still, regardless of what had transpired in the past, Eos had never been involved in those matters. Rather than coming from the Sanctifiers, who had been at turns friend and foe, she was more like a person stemming from the original concept of a "Sanctifier". Eos' affiliation and ideals were less emphasized compared to the other Sanctifiers, and she was more willing to engage in dialogue than they were. Few people could muster up strong objections to such a new friend, and this was especially true among those agents who had spent time around her.

After the initial wariness and tentative attempts to make contact with her, Eos soon gained widespread acceptance among everyone. Her unique approachability and personal charm made her life in the Oasis very enjoyable. While she was able to get along with almost everyone else, the reason for the strange mood between her and Persicaria remains a mystery. Very often, the people around them end up quietly separating the pair, even though they work well together when needed and even display a strange synchronicity at times.

"For some reason... It feels like the two of them could have been the best of friends."
—From an anonymous agent who once helped the two of them at work

Although she enjoys good relations with the agents of the Oasis, Eos' kindness is tempered with reticence and there is a hint of detachment in her attitude. She answers curious questions with forthright honesty but also responds to deeper probing with a playful shushing gesture. Just about any agent can strike up a conversation with her to gain pointers and insights when they're at a loss for what to do next, but it takes a special person to truly explore the depths of her heart.

That said, Eos acts completely differently in front of the Professor compared to others. This is not to say that she is not close to them; on the contrary, she is more intimate with and more relaxed around the Professor than with anyone else. Perhaps the two of them had some strange shared experience, but if Eos can ever be said to have lowered her guard, it is only when she is in a conversation with the Professor. For that reason, she has slowly revealed the hidden side of herself to the Professor—in addition to her attentiveness and thoughtfulness as an "assistant", she also reveals her strength of will as a "Greater" and the insights and philosophical nature of a "Sanctifier". She actively teases the Professor, aiming to see them in their rare moments of vexation, but at times, she behaves like someone who knows she has nowhere to hide. It is only when she is snugly within a safe harbor that one can hear her lack of direction and fragility through her murmured words.

Even after becoming used to life in the Oasis, Eos often finds herself reminiscing about her past in the Reverse Tower from time to time. Though Antonina and Persicaria did their best to collect the fragments of her neural pattern and reconstitute them, Eos' memory data and fighting power are nowhere near comparable to her impressions of her former self from her memories. Although she spent a long time inside Eosphorus' neural cloud as a memory fragment, she does not know what Eosphorus went through after her demise. 

For Eos, whose memories are incomplete, these occasionally blurred or clear snippets of memory are at times the basis of her sense of self, but also the source of more problems for her. Faced with the Oasis, which is dramatically different from the Reverse Tower, she had no choice but to silently adapt to it. As a result, she swiftly blended in with the others as though she had never met with any difficulty to begin with. It is only when she is alone that this special Greater Sanctifier falls into a long silence. Perhaps she is pondering her existence, her faith, and her experiences, or perhaps she is gazing at an unknown tomorrow by staring into the void. 

To this day, there are still people who view her with hidden wariness and doubt. However, there is no question that the leader of the Oasis has touched her elusive, hidden heart. The rest is simply a matter of time.
oathDesc: This time, keep me company to the very end too.

projections.desc:
Attire normally worn by this agent of Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"From the gentle light she came, settling henceforth out of the shadows."

projections.desc:
Attire worn by an agent of Magrasea at a certain stage in their progression, reflecting their very origins.
"Eosphorus, called such, for they bring light."

skinList.name: Argent Bergamasque
skinList.desc:
Stelliferous Ensemble—Listen with your soul. That concerto from between the streams of our vast galaxy is the music that carries feelings across the distant void.
"The silver moonlight whispers softly, guiding you and I to this lovely candle-lit balcony... Now then, shall we dance one last time before the performance ends? You won't decline... will you?"

skinList.name: Pearlescent Venus
skinList.desc:
I remember that dreamlike moment when you appeared before me, like the radiance of daybreak, as though you were my guiding star.
"Here and now, I swear this oath to follow and accompany you forever—and in so doing, I will finally be able to show you my truest self. Could you cosy up to me a little more..."

skinList.name: Dawnglimmer Aquamarine
skinList.desc:
Midmorning birdsong ebbs and falls as light hits your sleepy eyes. You are greeted by the familiar sight of a most enticing figure by the window. Your memories of her, perhaps too magnificent to describe, overlap with the face in front of you.
""Your eyes are giving off a lot of different signals, you know? Fufu... shall I guess at what you're thinking about right now?""
